question: What honor awaits even a habitual sinner who wears rudrākṣa?
premises: A person may be a doer of sinful acts
Such a person wears rudrākṣa constantly
Wearing rudrākṣa grants honor in Rudra's world
inference: Even a sinful doer who always wears it is honored in the world of Rudra.
plain_english: Even one who has done sinful deeds, if always wearing rudrākṣa, is honored in the world of Rudra.
